01 / THE ORIGINAL

Start with an honest baseline.

Lock the approved recipe and the words your guests see. New versions receive a new dish record.

These details become public, immutable contract records. Use non-confidential evidence only.

02 / SOMETHING CHANGED

Record the whole recipe.

Give reviewers a complete current ingredient statement, including the substitution.

Evidence is self-attested. GenLayer checks consistency; it cannot inspect a kitchen or authenticate a supplier.

A shared kitchen. Clear roles.

A RECORD YOU CAN REVISIT

More than an
AI opinion.

The contract locks your evidence, asks validators to independently review the same claims, and stores the agreed result. Staff decide what happens next.

Read the contract & methodology ↗
01

Words meet ingredients

Description, dietary claims and ingredient disclosure are checked separately, with exact evidence excerpts.

02

Uncertainty stays visible

Missing components or unsupported absence claims produce an inconclusive review. Consistent does not mean safe to eat.

03

History doesn’t get rewritten

A staff response adds context. It never deletes a flagged claim or turns an acknowledgement into a safety certificate.
